page.layout: One manuscript page, handwritten in brown ink in a cursive hand, filling the whole sheet. No printed blocks, columns or margins.
page.notes: The page carries only manuscript handwriting, not print, so there is no printed text to transcribe. The script is a cursive secretary-style hand, roughly 20 lines, that I cannot read reliably letter by letter, so I have not transcribed it. The sheet is yellowed and stained, with dark spots and a faint show-through of the reverse side. No printed page number, running head, catchword or signature is visible. At the right edge there is a narrow strip of further handwriting, also not printed.
